record: Amended H.R. 9334, the Workforce for Artificial Intelligence Trust Act, to add research on AI's effects on jobs, local economies and consumer costs (workforce and economy, not catastrophic risk).
Co-sponsored the Reverse Big Ugly Tax Breaks for Data Centers Act, removing tax breaks for AI data centers (cost and fairness, not AI risk).
grade_reason: In 2026 she spoke about AI several times (workforce, predictive pricing, youth mental health, data center electricity costs) but never about catastrophic risk.
